reference_policy.origin: Reuse existing frozen native-mean illustrative criteria only for exact native quantities; new cortical criteria require independent adjudication before percentage computation.
reference_policy.rounding: Use reported SD and plus/minus half of last displayed decimal unit in coherent scenarios; this is reporting-rounding sensitivity, not a confidence interval.

scope: Conditional independent-person population-mean variance = sample_sd^2 / n. This measures precision of the instrument-defined mean in each source-selected population. It does not measure individual-state precision, sensitivity to disease, transport, intervention effects, or whole-study quality.
